segments.text: Balance is arguably the most used piece of equipment in a chemistry laboratory, however
segments.zh: 天平可以说是化学实验室里使用最多的设备，然而，

segments.text: only proper technique, care, and maintenance will allow accurate measurements and will
segments.zh: 只有正确的操作技术、爱护和维护，才能得到准确的测量结果，并

segments.text: keep the balance functioning correctly.
segments.zh: 使天平保持正常工作。

segments.text: A balance is used to determine the mass of a solid or liquid.
segments.zh: 天平用于测定固体或液体的质量。

segments.text: You should remember that mass is defined as a measure of the amount of matter, regardless
segments.zh: 你应该记住，质量的定义是物质的量度，与所处

segments.text: of location, and that weight is defined as the force resulting from gravity, which varies
segments.zh: 位置无关；而重量的定义是由重力产生的力，它会

segments.text: from place to place depending on the distance from the center of the earth.
segments.zh: 因地而异，取决于离地心的距离。

segments.text: Because weight is directly proportional to mass on any location on earth, we will use
segments.zh: 由于在地球上任何地方重量都与质量成正比，我们将

segments.text: these terms interchangeably.
segments.zh: 混用这两个术语。

segments.text: If you decide to do some space travel, however, take care to remember the differences.
segments.zh: 不过，如果你决定去太空旅行，请务必记住它们的区别。

segments.text: Four major types of balances are commonly used, the triple beam balance, the top loading balance,
segments.zh: 常用的天平主要有四种：三梁天平、顶载天平、

segments.text: the analytical balance, and the micro-analytical balance.
segments.zh: 分析天平和微量分析天平。

segments.text: The difference between these balances is the amount of precision they afford.
segments.zh: 这些天平之间的区别在于它们所能达到的精度。

segments.text: The triple beam balance is precise to 10 milligrams, the top loading to 1 milligram, the analytical
segments.zh: 三梁天平精确到 10 毫克，顶载天平精确到 1 毫克，分析天平

segments.text: to one-tenth of a milligram, and the micro-analytical to one-thousandth of a milligram.
segments.zh: 精确到十分之一毫克，微量分析天平精确到千分之一毫克。

segments.text: Precision comes at a cost, however.
segments.zh: 不过，精度是有代价的。

segments.text: As precision increases, so does the susceptibility of the balance to environmental conditions
segments.zh: 精度越高，天平就越容易受环境条件的影响，

segments.text: as well as balance cost.
segments.zh: 天平的价格也越高。

segments.text: Therefore, you should choose a balance that is only as precise as necessary.
segments.zh: 因此，你选择的天平精度只要满足需要就够了。

segments.text: The two balances that you will most commonly encounter include the top loading balance
segments.zh: 你最常遇到的两种天平是顶载天平

segments.text: and the analytical balance.
segments.zh: 和分析天平。

segments.text: The top loading balance is typically used for rough measurements or for weighing chemicals
segments.zh: 顶载天平通常用于粗略测量，或者称量

segments.text: that will be used in excess.
segments.zh: 将过量使用的化学品。

segments.text: The analytical balance is used when precise measurements are desired.
segments.zh: 需要精确测量时，就使用分析天平。

segments.text: This video will focus on the use, care, and maintenance of an analytical balance.
segments.zh: 本视频将重点介绍分析天平的使用、爱护和维护。

segments.text: The topics discussed can be extrapolated to the top loading balance as well.
segments.zh: 所讨论的内容同样适用于顶载天平。

segments.text: To weigh an object on an analytical balance, turn the balance on if it is not on already
segments.zh: 用分析天平称量物体时，如果天平尚未开启，就先打开它，

segments.text: and allow it to warm up for 30 minutes.
segments.zh: 并让它预热 30 分钟。

segments.text: Inspect the balance and make sure that it is clean.
segments.zh: 检查天平，确保它是干净的。

segments.text: If necessary, clean off the balance pan with a soft painters brush.
segments.zh: 如有必要，用软的漆刷把秤盘清扫干净。

segments.text: Make sure the doors are closed and press the control bar to tear the balance.
segments.zh: 确保天平门已关好，然后按下控制键给天平去皮。

segments.text: A reading of 0.0 milligrams with no other display should appear if the balance is stable.
segments.zh: 如果天平稳定，应显示 0.0 毫克，并且没有其他显示。

segments.text: Simply place the object to be weighed in the center of the balance pan, close the doors,
segments.zh: 只需把待称物体放在秤盘中央，关好天平门，

segments.text: and record the weight that is indicated on the display after the numbers have ceased
segments.zh: 等显示屏上的数字不再

segments.text: to fluctuate.
segments.zh: 波动后，记录显示的重量。

segments.text: Remove the object from the balance pan and repeat the process two more times to ensure
segments.zh: 把物体从秤盘上取下，再重复这个过程两次，以确保

segments.text: precision.
segments.zh: 精密度。

segments.text: Finally, average the three readings to determine the weight of the object.
segments.zh: 最后，取三次读数的平均值，确定物体的重量。

segments.text: When weighing a chemical, care must be taken to never allow the chemical to touch the balance
segments.zh: 称量化学品时，必须注意绝不能让化学品接触到

segments.text: pan.
segments.zh: 秤盘。

segments.text: Instead, weigh the chemical in an appropriate container.
segments.zh: 而应当把化学品放在合适的容器里称量。

segments.text: If possible, weigh the chemical directly into the destination vessel.
segments.zh: 如有可能，直接把化学品称入目标容器中。

segments.text: This action eliminates a transfer step and the potential loss of material.
segments.zh: 这样可以省去一个转移步骤，避免可能的物料损失。

segments.text: If using the destination vessel is not possible, choose the smallest weigh boat or piece
segments.zh: 如果无法使用目标容器，就选择能有效盛放所需量化学品的

segments.text: of weigh paper that will effectively hold the desired amount of chemical.
segments.zh: 最小的称量舟或称量纸。

segments.text: The heavier the container, the less accurate the measurement, because just a small weight
segments.zh: 容器越重，测量就越不准确，因为这是在两个相对较大的数之间

segments.text: difference will exist between relatively large numbers.
segments.zh: 求一个很小的重量差。

segments.text: In addition, the more surface area, the more places for chemicals to stick to instead of
segments.zh: 此外，表面积越大，化学品就有越多的地方会粘附，而不是

segments.text: being transferred to the destination vessel.
segments.zh: 被转移到目标容器中。

segments.text: Place the weighing container on the balance pan, close the doors, and tear the balance.
segments.zh: 把称量容器放在秤盘上，关好天平门，然后去皮。

segments.text: If you are using weigh paper, first crease the paper along the diagonal to facilitate
segments.zh: 如果用称量纸，先沿对角线把纸折出折痕，以便

segments.text: the transfer of chemicals.
segments.zh: 转移化学品。

segments.text: Remove the weighing vessel from the balance and load an estimated amount of chemical
segments.zh: 把称量容器从天平上取下，用刮刀往上面加

segments.text: onto it with a spatula.
segments.zh: 估计量的化学品。

segments.text: Place the loaded weighing vessel back on the balance pan and close the doors to obtain
segments.zh: 把装好化学品的称量容器放回秤盘，关好天平门，

segments.text: a reading.
segments.zh: 读取读数。

segments.text: If the weight is too high, take the weigh vessel off the balance pan and transfer the
segments.zh: 如果重量太大，就把称量容器从秤盘上取下，把

segments.text: excess chemical into an appropriate waste container, never back into the original reagent
segments.zh: 多余的化学品转移到合适的废物容器中，绝不要倒回原来的试剂

segments.text: bottle.
segments.zh: 瓶。

segments.text: If the weight is too low, introduce more chemical to the weigh container.
segments.zh: 如果重量太小，就往称量容器中再加一些化学品。

segments.text: Remove the weigh vessel from the balance pan every time additional chemical is introduced.
segments.zh: 每次添加化学品时，都要把称量容器从秤盘上取下。

segments.text: Finally, transfer the chemical from the weigh paper or weigh boat into the appropriate reaction
segments.zh: 最后，把化学品从称量纸或称量舟转移到合适的反应

segments.text: vessel.
segments.zh: 容器中。

segments.text: Re-weigh the paper or boat to determine the exact amount of chemical that was transferred.
segments.zh: 再次称量称量纸或称量舟，以确定实际转移的化学品的准确量。

segments.text: After finishing with the balance, use a soft brush to clean up any solids from the balance
segments.zh: 用完天平后，用软刷清扫秤盘上的固体，

segments.text: pan and wipe up any liquids.
segments.zh: 并擦去任何液体。

segments.text: Close the doors to prevent dust and dirt from entering the balance.
segments.zh: 关好天平门，防止灰尘和污物进入天平。

segments.text: Clean the surrounding area and remove all items that you brought there.
segments.zh: 清理周围区域，拿走你带来的所有物品。

segments.text: Keep the balance and area surrounding it in better shape than when you found it.
segments.zh: 让天平及其周围区域保持得比你来时更好。

segments.text: The accuracy of your measurements depends on both good technique and environmental factors.
segments.zh: 测量的准确度既取决于良好的操作技术，也取决于环境因素。

segments.text: This video will highlight the most important of these guidelines.
segments.zh: 本视频将着重介绍其中最重要的几条准则。

segments.text: Keep the balance doors closed at all times to prevent air currents from causing the balance
segments.zh: 始终关好天平门，防止气流使秤盘

segments.text: pan to bounce slightly.
segments.zh: 轻微跳动。

segments.text: Never lean or lay a hand on the balance table to prevent unstable measurements.
segments.zh: 绝不要倚靠天平台或把手放在上面，以免测量不稳定。

segments.text: Wear gloves to prevent oil from depositing on the glassware, which falsely increases the
segments.zh: 戴上手套，防止油脂沉积在玻璃器皿上，使质量

segments.text: mass.
segments.zh: 虚增。

segments.text: Weigh a chemical directly into the reaction vessel.
segments.zh: 把化学品直接称入反应容器中。

segments.text: If that is not possible, use the smallest weigh boat or weigh paper that will hold
segments.zh: 如果无法做到，就用能盛放所需量化学品的

segments.text: your desired amount of chemical.
segments.zh: 最小的称量舟或称量纸。

segments.text: Ensure that the outside of the weigh vessel is completely dry before placing it on the
segments.zh: 在把称量容器放到秤盘上之前，确保其外部完全干燥，

segments.text: balance pan and be sure to place the object on the center of the balance pan.
segments.zh: 并一定要把物体放在秤盘中央。

segments.text: Allow moist chemicals to dry completely to avoid elevated readings and avoid breathing
segments.zh: 让潮湿的化学品完全干燥，以免读数偏高；也不要对着物体

segments.text: on an object, which condenses moisture on it and falsely increases its mass.
segments.zh: 呼气，那会使水汽在其上凝结，使质量虚增。

segments.text: Weigh ultra-dry objects or ones immediately removed from a desiccator at identical time
segments.zh: 对超干燥的物体或刚从干燥器中取出的物体，要在相同的时间

segments.text: intervals because they absorb moisture and gain weight the longer they sit in the atmosphere.
segments.zh: 间隔进行称量，因为它们在空气中放得越久，吸收的水分越多，重量也越大。

segments.text: Finally, allow hot or cold objects to reach room temperature before weighing.
segments.zh: 最后，要让过热或过冷的物体恢复到室温再称量。

segments.text: A hot object should be cooled in a desiccator to prevent the pickup of moisture.
segments.zh: 热的物体应在干燥器中冷却，以防吸收水分。

segments.text: Hot or cold objects create a convection current in the air around the balance pan,
segments.zh: 过热或过冷的物体会在秤盘周围的空气中形成对流，

segments.text: which reduces the air pressure on the balance pan and results in an unstable reading.
segments.zh: 使作用在秤盘上的气压降低，导致读数不稳定。

segments.text: The accuracy of a measurement is only as good as the instrument that is used.
segments.zh: 测量的准确度取决于所用仪器的好坏。

segments.text: To keep your balance functioning correctly, the following precautions should be taken.
segments.zh: 为使天平正常工作，应采取以下预防措施。

segments.text: Never weigh chemicals directly on the balance pan.
segments.zh: 绝不要把化学品直接放在秤盘上称量。

segments.text: Never add chemicals to the weighing vessel while it is on the balance pan.
segments.zh: 称量容器在秤盘上时，绝不要往里面加化学品。

segments.text: Never pour a chemical directly out of a reagent bottle and into the weigh vessel.
segments.zh: 绝不要把化学品直接从试剂瓶倒进称量容器。

segments.text: Use a spatula instead.
segments.zh: 而应使用刮刀。

segments.text: Pay attention to the maximum weight allowed by a particular balance and do not overload
segments.zh: 注意特定天平所允许的最大称量，不要使其

segments.text: it.
segments.zh: 超载。

segments.text: When using a balance, be aware of the warning signs which indicate that the balance is malfunctioning.
segments.zh: 使用天平时，要留意表明天平出现故障的警示迹象。

segments.text: After recording the weight of a chemical, remove it from the balance pan.
segments.zh: 记录完化学品的重量后，把它从秤盘上取下。

segments.text: The numbers on the display should again read 0.0 milligrams.
segments.zh: 显示屏上的数字应重新显示 0.0 毫克。

segments.text: If the displayed value is 0.3 milligrams or greater, then the zero level was significantly
segments.zh: 如果显示值为 0.3 毫克或更大，说明称量过程中零点发生了明显

segments.text: shifted during the weighing process and the chemical must be re-weighed.
segments.zh: 偏移，化学品必须重新称量。

segments.text: Check the amount of drift that is occurring.
segments.zh: 检查漂移的程度。

segments.text: Drift is characterized by weight readings that do not stabilize or by unstable readings
segments.zh: 漂移的特征是重量读数不稳定，或者在不加任何重量时

segments.text: with no weight applied.
segments.zh: 读数也不稳定。

segments.text: All analytical balances show some degree of fluctuation on their display and care
segments.zh: 所有分析天平的显示都会有一定程度的波动，应当

segments.text: should be taken to keep this drift at a minimum.
segments.zh: 注意把这种漂移降到最低。

segments.text: If you notice a change in the amount of instability on a particular balance, then it
segments.zh: 如果你注意到某台天平的不稳定程度发生了变化，那就说明它

segments.text: is malfunctioning.
segments.zh: 出了故障。

segments.text: Drift is affected by two environmental factors, temperature and static electricity.
segments.zh: 漂移受两个环境因素影响：温度和静电。

segments.text: It can be minimized through their manipulation.
segments.zh: 通过控制这两个因素，可以将漂移降到最低。

segments.text: The temperature of the room and the internal temperature of the balance should be kept
segments.zh: 室温和天平内部的温度应保持

segments.text: constant within 2 degrees Celsius.
segments.zh: 恒定，波动不超过 2 摄氏度。

segments.text: Static electricity can be minimized by avoiding the use of plastic containers and by maintaining
segments.zh: 要尽量减少静电，可以避免使用塑料容器，并保持

segments.text: the humidity above 40%.
segments.zh: 湿度在 40% 以上。

segments.text: If you notice excessive drift, the following situations may be occurring.
segments.zh: 如果你发现漂移过大，可能是出现了以下情况。

segments.text: The balance may be exposed to a draft.
segments.zh: 天平可能暴露在气流中。

segments.text: Close the doors.
segments.zh: 请关好天平门。

segments.text: The sample may be moist and undergoing evaporation on the balance pan.
segments.zh: 样品可能是潮湿的，正在秤盘上蒸发。

segments.text: The sample might be ultra-dry and absorbing moisture on the balance pan.
segments.zh: 样品可能是超干燥的，正在秤盘上吸收水分。

segments.text: The sample may not be at ambient temperature, which causes it to produce convection currents.
segments.zh: 样品可能没有处于环境温度，因而产生对流。

segments.text: The sample may be electrostatic.
segments.zh: 样品可能带有静电。

segments.text: If you notice drift while weighing a sample, the most accurate reading is the first number
segments.zh: 如果你在称量样品时发现漂移，最准确的读数是最先出现

segments.text: that appeared and was maintained for 2 seconds.
segments.zh: 并保持了 2 秒的那个数字。

segments.text: So far, we've discussed the use of a balance for weighing solids.
segments.zh: 到目前为止，我们讨论了用天平称量固体。

segments.text: However, a balance may also be used to weigh liquid samples.
segments.zh: 不过，天平也可以用来称量液体样品。

segments.text: Generally, it is easier and more accurate to determine the volume of a liquid by using
segments.zh: 一般来说，用精密的容量玻璃器皿来测定液体的体积，会更容易也更准确，

segments.text: precision volumetric glassware such as a burette, glass pipette, syringe or automatic pipette
segments.zh: 比如滴定管、玻璃移液管、注射器或移液器，

segments.text: and then use the liquid's density to calculate its mass.
segments.zh: 然后再用液体的密度计算其质量。

segments.text: However, directly measuring the weight of a liquid is preferred in some situations, such
segments.zh: 不过，在某些情况下更适合直接测量液体的重量，比如

segments.text: as when working with a viscous liquid.
segments.zh: 处理黏稠液体时。

segments.text: As a final note, when weighing a volatile liquid or one that evaporates readily, use
segments.zh: 最后要注意，称量易挥发或容易蒸发的液体时，要使用

segments.text: a weighing bottle with a lid.
segments.zh: 带盖的称量瓶。

segments.text: Although using a balance is a relatively simple task, accurate measurements can only be ensured
segments.zh: 虽然使用天平是一项相对简单的工作，但只有通过良好的操作技术，

segments.text: through good technique.
segments.zh: 才能确保测量准确。

segments.text: Exceptional care must be taken to maintain a clean environment which helps to keep the
segments.zh: 必须格外注意保持环境整洁，这有助于使

segments.text: balance functioning properly.
segments.zh: 天平正常工作。
